correctStatements.text: At 02:14 wei-ling.tan reported that the acquirer gateway was returning TLS handshake failures and authorisations were down.
Priya_Raghunathan said roughly 38% of attempts were failing, with Singaporean cardholders affected first.
o.mbeki found that the intermediate certificate had been swapped at 01:50 by the vendor-rotation job.
At 02:26 wei-ling.tan noticed that the trust bundle on pay-edge-3 and pay-edge-4 still held the old chain.
At 02:32 singapore-payments-oncall-rotation-b escalated to the acquirer relationship manager in Kuala Lumpur.
At 02:40 o.mbeki decided to push the refreshed trust bundle to all 6 edge hosts.
At 02:46 Priya_Raghunathan reported the bundle was deployed on 4 of 6 hosts and failures fell from 38% to 9%.
o.mbeki said the last two hosts were stuck behind a pending config lock that was cleared by hand.
At 02:55 wei-ling.tan confirmed all edges were green and the authorisation rate was back above 99.5%.
singapore-payments-oncall-rotation-b noted about 70 minutes of card volume was lost and finance was sizing it.
Action item: pin the certificate chain in a staging canary before every rotation, owner o.mbeki.
Action item: page the vendor contact automatically when the rotation job runs, owner Priya_Raghunathan.
o.mbeki summarised that a vendor certificate rotation left stale trust bundles on the edge hosts and broke card authorisations for about 70 minutes.
